sources.name: Xiaomi Australia - Xiaomi 17 Specs
sources.finding: Confirms the Australian Xiaomi 17 product and AU storage configurations 12GB+256GB and 12GB+512GB with UFS 4.1.

sources.name: Global Certification Forum record indexed by device.report
sources.finding: Lists Xiaomi 17 as model 25113PN0EG under Xiaomi Communications Co., Ltd. with Global Certification Forum certification.

sources.name: Optus TAC Checker evidence indexed by FCCID.io
sources.finding: Optus TAC Checker evidence identifies device name 17 with alias Xiaomi 25113PN0EG; the same record links Xiaomi Communications Co., Ltd. FCC evidence for PN0EG.

safety_notes: No production catalogue row is changed by this evidence package.
No pricing, inventory or pricing-history record is changed.
The candidate is the global model identifier supported by regulatory evidence and Australian network identity evidence; it is not inferred from Xiaomi naming convention alone.
Recheck the live row, dependencies, active collisions, and Australian/global identity immediately before any future production write.
Abort if Xiaomi Australia or Australian regulatory evidence demonstrates a distinct Australian-only hardware variant.
Any production update requires explicit human authorization.
